'''Laqasa Trill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
A [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] from [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], Laqasa Trill was an accomplished hunter and a [[Jedi Seeker/Legends|Jedi Seeker]] who taught the philosophy that overpopulated game species ought to be hunted and rogue predators eradicated. A form of [[Meditation/Legends#Walking meditation|walking meditation]], Trill used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to connect with her prey, and never used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during a hunt. Instead, Trill used tools utilized by local hunters and developed her own tools and weapons during her journeys. Rarely returning to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Trill was called upon to slay a pack of dangerous camouflaging beasts ravaging Devaron's northern continent. Developing the [[Eyes of Laqasa]], a pair of modified [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]], Trill tracked and destroyed the beasts, donning their skins as a [[Color/Legends|color]]-changing [[Robe/Legends|robe]]. Leaving the Eyes in a hunting lodge within the [[Blue Mountains]], Trill's hunt was legendary among her people during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="NoP" />
